spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** When the Divine established and ordered the discrete degrees of spiritual life, He arranged each degree so that it is sustained by the degree above it, and also by a still more interior degree within. The outermost degree consists of the five genera of evil and falsity — both as perversions of the will and as perversions of the understanding.

**¶3:** This is why one degree of order is made to depend upon another. The five genera of falsity from evil are held in equilibrium by the five powers of divine truth in its luminous aspect, which proceed from the Divine Human; because all opposition from hell is kept intertwined with and restrained by these corresponding powers of heaven. Evil cannot act except insofar as it is counterbalanced by the good that opposes it.

**¶4:** Also, within this ordering are the five derivative powers of the [GAP-1] divine proceeding in its vivifying activity; because all spiritual structure is sustained from these inflowing powers, it being [GAP-2] that the Divine is perceived through them as well, and the oth[GAP-3]er degrees of heavenly order are sustained in succession from them.

**¶5:** And this is the One who descended to [GAP-4] the expanses of interior truth in the higher degrees [GAP-5], which constitutes a single unified degree of divine order — the great [GAP-6] Divine Good governing through sovereign truth, who e[GAP-7]xists and reigns [GAP-8] throughout the whole of the Grand Human.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of Darkness, males and females.
This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of Darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.

Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [through them that one has he]ard (?) him too, the oth[ers are hung in their order] after them.
And this is the one who came to [set and arrange the fi]rmaments above [and that] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists and reigns] within the [whole body] of the universe.

fills.explanation: The "five sons of the Living Spirit" is standard Manichaean cosmological terminology, and the spiritual reading's "vivifying activity" (= life-giving) directly corresponds to "Living."

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading specifies "the Divine is perceived through them as well"; in the text's register "heard him too" = "perceived the Divine as well," and the clause "through them that one has heard him too" expresses that the Divine is apprehended through these sustaining powers.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading specifies "other degrees of heavenly order are sustained in succession"; using the chapter's own key verb "hung" (from ¶3's "he hung one zone on a zone") to express successive suspension of degrees in their proper order.

The spiritual reading describes establishing the expanses of interior truth in the higher degrees; "set and arrange the firmaments above" uses the chapter's constructive vocabulary (paralleling ¶2's "built and constructed") to describe the ordering of the cosmic expanses.

A small connective phrase is needed to link "firmaments above" to the relative clause "which is in one zone"; "and that" serves as a demonstrative bridge corresponding to the spiritual reading's transition to "which constitutes a single unified degree."

The King of Honour is one of the five sons of the Living Spirit in Manichaean cosmology who sustains the firmaments, and the spiritual reading's "Divine Good governing through sovereign truth" maps precisely to this royal-sovereign figure.

The spiritual reading specifies "exists and reigns" as the two predicates of this figure; "e" + "xists and reigns" = "exists and reigns," matching the sovereign governance described in the spiritual sense.

The spiritual reading specifies "throughout the whole of the Grand Human"; in the Kephalaia's natural-plane register, "whole body of the universe" expresses the Maximus Homo concept — the cosmos as a single living form through which the Divine governs.
